en.title: FadeSlot
en.text:
FadeSlot is a full-stack multi-tenant SaaS platform built from the ground up for barber shops, tattoo studios, and appointment-driven businesses. Live in production with real customers, subscription billing, and active feature development.

  • Booking & scheduling engine with real-time availability, multi-staff, multi-location, and intelligent slot management.
  • Operational platform covering client profiles, POS sales, inventory tracking, payments, and reviews.
  • Multi-tenant architecture with tenant isolation, role-based access (RBAC), and per-business configuration.
  • Subscription billing via Paddle: plans, trials, upgrades, and revenue analytics.
  • Cloud infrastructure on AWS S3 for media + scalable PostgreSQL data layer.
  • Automated notifications across booking flows, reminders, and operational events.
  • Bilingual (EN/ES), mobile-first product designed for international reach.
  • Analytics dashboards for business performance, retention, and operational KPIs.

Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end: product, architecture, backend, frontend, infrastructure, billing, and deployment.

es.title: FadeSlot
es.text:
FadeSlot es una plataforma SaaS multi-tenant full-stack construida desde cero para barberías, estudios de tatuaje y negocios basados en citas. En producción con clientes reales, billing por suscripción y desarrollo activo de features.

  • Motor de reservas y agendamiento con disponibilidad en tiempo real, multi-staff, multi-sede y gestión inteligente de slots.
  • Plataforma operativa con perfiles de cliente, ventas POS, inventario, pagos y reseñas.
  • Arquitectura multi-tenant con aislamiento por tenant, control de acceso por roles (RBAC) y configuración por negocio.
  • Facturación por suscripción con Paddle: planes, trials, upgrades y analítica de ingresos.
  • Infraestructura cloud en AWS S3 para media y capa de datos PostgreSQL escalable.
  • Notificaciones automatizadas en flujos de reserva, recordatorios y eventos operativos.
  • Bilingüe (EN/ES), producto mobile-first pensado para alcance internacional.
  • Dashboards analíticos de desempeño, retención y KPIs operativos.

Diseñado, construido y lanzado end-to-end: producto, arquitectura, backend, frontend, infraestructura, billing y despliegue.

fr.title: FadeSlot
fr.text:
FadeSlot est une plateforme SaaS multi-tenant full-stack conçue de zéro pour les salons de coiffure, studios de tatouage et entreprises basées sur le rendez-vous. En production avec de vrais clients, facturation par abonnement et développement continu.

  • Moteur de réservation avec disponibilité temps réel, multi-staff, multi-site et gestion intelligente des créneaux.
  • Plateforme opérationnelle : profils clients, POS, inventaire, paiements, avis.
  • Architecture multi-tenant avec isolation par tenant, RBAC et configuration par entreprise.
  • Abonnements via Paddle: plans, essais, upgrades, analytics de revenus.
  • Infrastructure cloud sur AWS S3 pour le média et couche de données PostgreSQL scalable.
  • Notifications automatisées sur les flux de réservation, rappels et événements opérationnels.
  • Bilingue (EN/ES), produit mobile-first pensé pour l'international.
  • Dashboards analytiques de performance, rétention et KPIs opérationnels.

Conçu, construit et livré de bout en bout: produit, architecture, backend, frontend, infrastructure, billing et déploiement.

ko.title: FadeSlot
ko.text:
FadeSlot은 이발소, 타투 스튜디오, 예약 기반 비즈니스를 위해 처음부터 구축한 풀스택 멀티 테넌트 SaaS 플랫폼입니다. 실제 고객, 구독 빌링, 활발한 기능 개발과 함께 프로덕션에서 운영 중입니다.

  • 실시간 가용성, 멀티 스태프·멀티 로케이션, 지능형 슬롯 관리 기능을 갖춘 예약·스케줄링 엔진.
  • 고객 프로필, POS 판매, 재고 추적, 결제, 리뷰를 아우르는 운영 플랫폼.
  • 테넌트 격리, 역할 기반 접근 제어(RBAC), 비즈니스별 구성을 지원하는 멀티 테넌트 아키텍처.
  • Paddle 기반 구독 빌링: 플랜, 트라이얼, 업그레이드, 매출 분석.
  • 미디어 저장을 위한 AWS S3와 확장 가능한 PostgreSQL 데이터 레이어로 구성된 클라우드 인프라.
  • 예약 플로우, 리마인더, 운영 이벤트 전반의 자동 알림.
  • 국제 시장을 겨냥한 이중 언어(EN/ES) 모바일 퍼스트 제품.
  • 비즈니스 성과, 리텐션, 운영 KPI를 위한 분석 대시보드.

제품, 아키텍처, 백엔드, 프론트엔드, 인프라, 빌링, 배포까지 엔드투엔드로 설계·구축·출시.

en.title: BioSwift
en.text:
BioSwift is a SaaS-grade operational platform built for the biomedical industry: designed to digitize and automate how biomedical companies run their entire operation. Shipped to production and running real business workflows.

  • Operational system covering clients, locations, equipment, spare parts, inventory, and service orders in real time.
  • Business process automation across service workflows, reporting, and operational tracking.
  • Dashboards & analytics for performance monitoring and data-driven decisions.
  • AWS-backed infrastructure: scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Multi-department architecture supporting growing data and user volumes.

es.title: BioSwift
es.text:
BioSwift es una plataforma operativa SaaS construida para la industria biomédica: diseñada para digitalizar y automatizar toda la operación de empresas biomédicas. En producción y corriendo flujos de negocio reales.

  • Sistema operativo de clientes, sedes, equipos, repuestos, inventario y órdenes de servicio en tiempo real.
  • Automatización de procesos de negocio en flujos de servicio, reportería y seguimiento operativo.
  • Dashboards y analítica para monitoreo de desempeño y decisiones data-driven.
  • Infraestructura AWS: escalable, segura y lista para producción.
  • Arquitectura multi-departamento que soporta crecimiento de datos y usuarios.

fr.title: BioSwift
fr.text:
BioSwift est une plateforme opérationnelle SaaS construite pour l'industrie biomédicale: pensée pour digitaliser et automatiser toute l'opération des entreprises biomédicales. En production, exécutant de vrais workflows business.

  • Système opérationnel : clients, sites, équipements, pièces, inventaire et ordres de service en temps réel.
  • Automatisation des processus business sur les workflows de service, reporting et suivi opérationnel.
  • Dashboards et analytics pour monitoring et décisions data-driven.
  • Infrastructure AWS: scalable, sécurisée, production-ready.
  • Architecture multi-département qui suit la croissance des données et des utilisateurs.

ko.title: BioSwift
ko.text:
BioSwift는 의료기기 산업을 위해 구축된 SaaS급 운영 플랫폼으로, 의료기기 기업의 전체 운영을 디지털화·자동화하기 위해 설계되었습니다. 프로덕션에 출시되어 실제 비즈니스 워크플로우를 운영 중입니다.

  • 고객, 위치, 장비, 부품, 재고, 서비스 주문을 실시간으로 관리하는 운영 시스템.
  • 서비스 워크플로우, 리포팅, 운영 추적 전반의 비즈니스 프로세스 자동화.
  • 성능 모니터링과 데이터 기반 의사결정을 위한 대시보드와 분석.
  • 확장 가능하고 안전한 프로덕션 레벨의 AWS 인프라.
  • 데이터와 사용자 증가를 지원하는 멀티 부서 아키텍처.

en.title: El Ahorro
en.text:
El Ahorro is an operational SaaS platform built for retail businesses: from independent stores to multi-location supermarkets. Designed to centralize inventory, sales, billing, and supplier workflows in a single product.

  • Inventory & operations with real-time stock, purchase flows, and supplier management.
  • Sales & billing workflows tailored to retail operations.
  • Analytics dashboards focused on productivity, margins, and decisions.
  • Designed for scalable business workflows across multiple business sizes.

Founded and led as CEO & Product Owner: driving direction, architecture, and execution.

es.title: El Ahorro
es.text:
El Ahorro es una plataforma SaaS operativa construida para negocios de retail: desde tiendas independientes hasta supermercados multi-sede. Diseñada para centralizar inventario, ventas, facturación y proveedores en un solo producto.

  • Inventario y operaciones con stock en tiempo real, flujos de compra y gestión de proveedores.
  • Ventas y facturación adaptadas a operaciones de retail.
  • Dashboards analíticos enfocados en productividad, márgenes y decisiones.
  • Diseñada para flujos de negocio escalables en distintos tamaños de empresa.

Fundada y liderada como CEO y Product Owner: dirigiendo dirección, arquitectura y ejecución.

fr.title: El Ahorro
fr.text:
El Ahorro est une plateforme SaaS opérationnelle conçue pour les entreprises de retail: du commerce indépendant aux supermarchés multi-sites. Pensée pour centraliser inventaire, ventes, facturation et fournisseurs dans un seul produit.

  • Inventaire & opérations avec stock temps réel, flux d'achat et gestion fournisseurs.
  • Ventes & facturation adaptées aux opérations retail.
  • Dashboards analytiques centrés sur productivité, marges et décisions.
  • Conçue pour des workflows scalables à toutes tailles d'entreprise.

Fondée et dirigée en tant que CEO & Product Owner: pilotant direction, architecture et exécution.

ko.title: El Ahorro
ko.text:
El Ahorro는 독립 매장부터 다중 지점 슈퍼마켓까지 모든 규모의 리테일 비즈니스를 위한 운영 SaaS 플랫폼입니다. 재고, 판매, 빌링, 공급업체 워크플로우를 하나의 제품에서 중앙화하기 위해 설계되었습니다.

  • 실시간 재고, 구매 플로우, 공급업체 관리를 갖춘 인벤토리 및 운영.
  • 리테일 운영에 맞춰진 판매 및 빌링 워크플로우.
  • 생산성, 마진, 의사결정에 초점을 둔 분석 대시보드.
  • 다양한 규모의 비즈니스를 지원하는 확장 가능한 비즈니스 워크플로우.

CEO & 제품 오너로서 방향성, 아키텍처, 실행을 리드.
